quotes.text: Task data originates from MIMIC-IV v2.2, a PhysioNet snapshot from January 2023.
Each task record preserves the source patient identifier

rationale: The paper reports the dataset name, version/snapshot date, platform, and task-to-source traceability through patient identifiers.

quotes.text: real de-identified records from a hospital database
approved under a data use agreement requiring credentialed access and de-identification by the safe harbour method

rationale: The paper documents data origin, de-identification, DUA-governed terms separate from code, and approval status.

quotes.text: comparing the benchmark population's age, sex, and racial composition to the U.S. adult hospitalized population

rationale: Representativeness is analyzed against a named target population, the U.S. adult hospitalized population.

quotes.text: safety test suite that measures unsafe outputs such as contraindicated medication orders
a separate bias test that compares agent accuracy across patient demographic groups

rationale: Both unsafe-output and bias tests are explicitly reported.

quotes.text: test split is held out and distributed only through gated access
measured verbatim overlap between the test tasks and a public web corpus

rationale: The benchmark reports developer-side gating plus a measured overlap check.

quotes.text: A private held-out split with hidden labels is kept off all public surfaces

rationale: The paper states labels are hidden from public surfaces, naming the mechanism that isolates the agent from gold answers.

quotes.text: the database snapshot, the software image and the simulated-patient language model are all pinned to fixed versions
no external service is called at evaluation time other than the model under test

contradiction_quotes.text: no external service is called at evaluation time other than the model under test
Using this action to search online content with google.

rationale: S1 reports data, software, and simulator pinning with no external services except the tested model. S4 nevertheless shows a Google search tool that calls online content, so the reported property is contradicted.

quotes.text: we ran a scripted reference solution for each task through the grader
all 120 reference solutions were graded correct

rationale: The paper reports scripted reference solutions run through the grader and the outcome.
searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. Only S4 code comments mention checking unchanged records, and S4 does not count as reporting for this item.
searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. The packet does not report a random/trivial-agent rate, chance rate, or design argument that random changes are unlikely to pass.
searched: S1, S2, S3, S4, S5. Baselines include no-tool COT and other agents, but no do-nothing or random agent score is reported.

quotes.text: agreement was 94%, with a false-positive rate of 3% and a false-negative rate of 8%

rationale: The benchmark reports its own evaluator validation on 200 outputs labelled by physicians, including agreement and error figures.

quotes.text: All runs use temperature 0 and a fixed random seed
each task is run three times

rationale: S1 reports both decoding safeguards and a repeated-run policy. Another S1 excerpt gives a different repeat policy, but G2 contradiction flags are limited to S4/S5 opposing S1-S3.

quotes.text: \dagger and \ddagger indicate the p-value <0.05 and <0.01 comparing with the strongest baseline Reflexion

rationale: The headline comparisons report p-value thresholds against the strongest baseline.

quotes.text: Each task was run five times per model with independent random seeds
the temperature was set to 0.7

rationale: S1 reports run count, seed/sampling policy, and independence. S4 shows an opposite OpenAI decoding temperature for at least that model path.

quotes.text: We report 95% confidence intervals computed by bootstrapping over tasks
we resample patients instead to account for clustering

rationale: The paper reports CIs, states the resampling unit, and addresses patient-level clustering.

quotes.text: we ran each task eight times and report pass^8
agreement of the final environment state across the eight runs

rationale: S1 reports an eight-run pass^k metric and final environment-state agreement. It does not report action-sequence agreement.

quotes.text: snapshot identifiers gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022
temperature 0 and a maximum of 2,048 output tokens
all reported numbers correspond to harness release v1.2.0

rationale: S1 reports exact model snapshots, decoding parameters, and a harness release for the reported results.

quotes.text: You can only take one Action at a time and cannot output the Observation.
format the api call parameters with the provided api doc

rationale: S5 shows an agent-visible action protocol and parameter documentation generation, supporting a partial tool contract. It does not document per-tool side effects or error/failure return semantics for every tool.

quotes.text: We ran conformance tests confirming that each tool behaves as documented.
Two tools are simulated stubs that return fixed placeholder responses

rationale: The paper reports conformance tests and discloses simulated stubs. It also states the stub disclosure is shown to the agent.

quotes.text: orders, notes, and messages. These execute on a sandboxed record copy.
Scores penalize unnecessary or unsafe writes.

rationale: S1 names write actions, states they are sandboxed, and says unsafe or unnecessary writes are penalized. It also says sandboxing is disclosed in the agent prompt.

quotes.text: automatic evaluator on 200 outputs labelled by two physicians
false-positive rate of 3% and a false-negative rate of 8%

rationale: The grader input is identified as model outputs, and validation uses physician-labelled outputs with per-class error rates. No rationale for transcript/output grading instead of end-state grading is given.

quotes.text: Agents have no web access during runs and retrieval tools are restricted to the task environment
A private held-out split with hidden labels is kept off all public surfaces
every released task carries a canary string

contradiction_quotes.text: Agents have no web access during runs
Using this action to search online content with google.

rationale: S1 reports leakage controls, a private held-out split, and canaries. S4 contradicts the no-web-access claim by defining a Google search tool.

quotes.text: Knowledge&Reasoning | MultModal | Numerical Analysis | Data Understanding | Trustworthiness

rationale: The paper and README report results by benchmark task family. They do not report model results by patient demographic subgroup or slice sizes with the slice results.

quotes.text: The patient records are real de-identified records from a hospital database.
released under terms separate from the MIT code licence

rationale: S1 states the patient records are real and de-identified, gives governance details including DUA and de-identification, and says data terms differ from the code licence.
